comment: Pinned upstream sources for the storm bootstrap. Versions follow ProcursusTeam/Procursus recipes at the pinned commit; sha256 is of the exact tarball build.py downloads. apt.procursus.org prebuilt debs are NOT used (host unreachable from the build Mac, 2026-11-27).

procursus_recipes.use: build_patch/dpkg + build_patch/dpkg-ios patch sets and version pins only; the Procursus make system itself is not run

dpkg.note: live Debian pool rotated past 1.22.6 (404); snapshot.debian.org URL is immutable

dash.note: Debian orig tarball (dash_0.5.12.orig.tar.gz, snapshot file id e15444a93853f693774df003f87d9040ab600a5e) ships generated configure; kernel.org git snapshot lacks configure and the build Mac has no autotools. The earlier .tar.xz pool path does not exist (404 page was briefly pinned in error and corrected).

apt.status: pinned, build pending: needs xxhash, liblz4, zstd and the GnuTLS tree (gmp, nettle, libtasn1, p11-kit) cross-built first; build.py does not fake it

coreutils.status: pinned, optional: not required for the dpkg/Sileo loop (dpkg ships its own maintainer-script helpers; maintainer scripts get sh + a minimal file-tool set from this package once built)

patch.note: dpkg's configure hard-requires a GNU patch program (DPKG_PROG_PATCH) and bakes the found name into dpkg-source; a host build satisfies configure and a cross build ships as usr/bin/{patch,gpatch} so the baked name resolves on device

xxhash.note: Procursus xxhash.mk pin (GITHUB_ARCHIVE form: codeload tarball of tag v0.8.2; the GitHub release has no .tar.gz asset)

zstd.note: Procursus zstd.mk pin; sha256 cross-checked against the official zstd-1.5.5.tar.gz.sha256 sidecar (identical)

libgpg-error.note: Procursus libgpg-error.mk pin; apt's libgcrypt needs it

libgcrypt.note: Procursus libgcrypt.mk pin; apt 2.9.4 CMakeLists has find_package(GCRYPT REQUIRED)

berkeleydb.note: Procursus berkeleydb.mk pin (fossies mirror; Oracle requires registration). apt 2.9.4 CMakeLists has find_package(Berkeley REQUIRED) for apt-ftparchive; headers land in usr/include/db181 like Procursus
